nodes.label: Terminal Client Lifecycle Guards
nodes.rationale: Guard terminal client lifecycle states in memory when persistent storage is optional.

nodes.label: Direct Persistence Side-Effect Assertions
nodes.rationale: Assert each user action persistence side effect directly instead of relying on an equivalent platform path.

nodes.label: Custom Next.js Service Worker
nodes.rationale: Keep Next.js 16 and use a small custom service worker to reduce stack change and visual regression risk.

nodes.label: Same-Origin Cache Allowlist
nodes.rationale: A positive restricted caching policy is safer than excluding dynamic data after interception.

nodes.label: Safe PWA Update Activation
nodes.rationale: Waiting workers are activated only at a safe point to avoid state loss and shell/chunk inconsistency.

nodes.label: Platform-Specific Installable Assets
nodes.rationale: Android and iOS masks require distinct brand-derived assets rather than resizing a rectangular logo.

nodes.label: Compact Install Promotion
nodes.rationale: A compact notice above navigation preserves the participant flow and keeps operational notices visually prioritary.

nodes.label: Progressive Install Enhancement
nodes.rationale: Installation discovery must remain non-blocking and defer to offline and update states.

nodes.label: PWA Migration Boundary
nodes.rationale: Transform the existing frontend into an installable resilient PWA without adding business functionality or redesigning the experience.

nodes.label: Offline Data Honesty
nodes.rationale: Dynamic data must not appear current while unavailable or potentially stale.

nodes.label: Explicit Cache Warmup
nodes.rationale: Resource Timing warmup plus CACHE_READY avoids depending solely on the browser HTTP cache.

nodes.label: Progressive Offline Experience
nodes.rationale: Installation and offline behavior should improve the experience without blocking ordinary web access.

nodes.label: Cookie Session Reconstruction
nodes.rationale: Once /users/me exists, restore the current user using the HttpOnly cookie and stop persisting the JavaScript-accessible token.
